There is a on-going effort #86225 to decouple the ProcessGroup and Backend abstraction so that a single process group object can map to several backends based on the device type of the input and output tensors.
distributed_c10d.py has been reworked as part of this effort. However, it seems like custom backends are not being handled correctly --

      in

After the above line, we never set backend_type for custom backends and that lead to an invalid reference error here:

      in
      88942a3
    
  
  
    

        
          
           if backend in [Backend.GLOO, Backend.NCCL, Backend.UCC, Backend.MPI]: 
        

        
          
               for device in backend_config.get_device_backend_map().keys():

.
